cancelIntentLabel: Delete this intent (reason required; soft or hard delete)
workerResumed: Worker #{id} resumed; waiting to be claimed again
workerHardDeleted: Worker #{id} and its exclusive downstream nodes were permanently deleted{extra}
workerSoftDeleted: Worker #{id} deleted (reason recorded; the planner will replan accordingly)
sseReconnecting: Live connection interrupted; reconnecting automatically (history remains visible)
tokenTooltip: Input {input} · Output {output} · Cache read {cacheRead} · Cache write {cacheWrite}
newMainTitle: New main agent session (clears context; task state is kept)
scrollUpHint: Scroll up to load earlier history
runDurationTitle: Run duration (first step to last step)
intentDeleted: This intent was deleted by the user
intentDeletedHint: (Execution stopped; the planner has been notified. The intent and its outputs are kept, and history is shown below)
emptyMain: No conversation yet. Send a message to the main agent below to guide exploration or intervene.
chatAria: Send a message to the main agent
mainBusyPlaceholder: The main agent is running; type /btw to ask a side question…
mainPlaceholder: Message the main agent; @ to reference findings, assets, etc…
workerPlaceholder: Message Worker #{id}; @ to reference records and adjust its direction…
continueTitle: Continue execution without sending a message
hardDeleteDesc: Hard delete physically removes this intent and the downstream nodes supported only by it (cascading to the leaves to avoid orphaned data); shared nodes, goals and task-root facts are kept. This cannot be undone. The planner receives the deletion notice and replans accordingly.
softDeleteDesc: Soft delete marks this intent as “deleted” and records the reason; the intent node, execution records, registered facts and findings are all kept. The planner receives “intent deleted by user + reason” and replans accordingly.
reasonPlaceholder: Explain why this intent is being deleted, e.g. wrong direction / goal no longer valid / duplicates another intent…
newSessionDesc: The current session will be archived (you can switch back at any time), and the main agent continues with a clean context. The task’s graph, assets and goal are not affected.
workerMessageSent: Message sent to Worker #{id}; execution resumed immediately
